cohort: 131 women diagnosed with GDM who received inpatient care between January 2018 and December 2018, pair-matched 1:1 for age with 131 controls.
finding: BMI >23 kg/m2 and a spacing gap of <2 years between pregnancies were significant risk factors for GDM.
mod_finding: Women with previous vaginal births had a diminished risk of developing GDM.
